title: Research: partitioned independent-walks 9q priced obstruction (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Freestanding `#840`-style priced obstruction under [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898) at `(b,a,x)=(38,2,2)`. Companion **Q=9 partitioned independent dual** alphabet on `(2,7)/(3,6)/(4,5)` after the Q=8 independent / one-repeat / two-repeat / shared-dirt / three-repeat series.

| Dual schedule | Covering pairs | Min R | Tariff @ X=0 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Partition `(2,7)` | 20512576 | **80** | **502** |
| Partition `(3,6)` | 69370560 | 88 | 518 |
| Partition `(4,5)` | 122561600 | 92 | 526 |

Exact covering min is **R=80** on `(2,7)`; tariff floor **502 > 436** (also above same-walk Q=9 floor 466). No undercut of the six-query endpoint; **no new kappa**.

**Scoped obstruction / priced alphabet.** Leave-alone through [#2868](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2868) / [#2867](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2867) / [#2861](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2861) / [#2860](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2860) / [#2858](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2858) / [#2851](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2851) was not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/independent-walks-9q/`.
Tip: `1e15ae28c15d56f7c61220564207d571972a33a4`.

Exact: partition min **R=80**; tariff floor **502**; no undercut of 436.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-9q/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/independent-walks-9q/verify.py --quick
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-9q/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-9q/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/independent-walks-9q
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_9Q_OBSTRUCTION partition_min_R=80 ... tariff_floor=502 ... no_undercut_partitioned_independent_walks_q9 ... no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_9Q_QUICK ...
PASS_INDEPENDENT_PARTITIONED_WALKS_9Q ...
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_9Q_PACKAGE_TESTS ...
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/independent-walks-9q outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O --quick` also passes.

## Overlap and credit

Closest prior: [#2851](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2851) (Q=8 partitioned independent), [#2868](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2868) (three-repeat OQ2), [#2867](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2867). Freestanding Q=9 package path; no competing open PR at refresh.
